title: ResponderState Zeroize impl does not reset completed flag
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/responder.rs
Line: 91
Function: Zeroize::zeroize for ResponderState
Category: state-integrity

## Description
Zeroize impl does not reset `completed` flag to false. Same issue as InitiatorState - poison() after completed=true leaves inconsistent state.

## Fix
Add `self.completed = false;` to the Zeroize impl for ResponderState
